messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — embeddings-service error rate spike (>25% 5xx) in eu-west1 — paging: @Aisha Patel primary, @Tom Nguyen secondary — incident page: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-087 — please acknowledge
Aisha Patel: ack — looking
Tom Nguyen: ack, I'm here as secondary. I'll shadow until handoff at 06:00 UTC.
Riley Chen: seeing 502/504s from relay -> embeddings path in the logs, looks like KV cache thrash + backend model pod evictions. Affected traffic: ~3% of requests, mostly customers in EU.
Aisha Patel: thanks Riley. quick mitigation idea: pin traffic to older model variant (quantized) and scale up embeddings pool. doing rollout now.
Aisha Patel: run: ```kubectl scale deployment embeddings-pool-eu --replicas=6 -n inference-prod```
incident-bot: Autoscaler triggered: +2 pods requested, pending scheduling (insufficient nvidia-gpu-rtx). Current queue: 2 pods.
Tom Nguyen: if scheduling is slow we can: 1) re-route eu-west1 traffic to eu-central for 10m, or 2) fallback to model-v1-quant. Which do you prefer?
Aisha Patel: prefer fallback to model-v1-quant for quick fix; re-route only if fallback fails. Applying traffic rule now.
Priya Kapoor: adding runbook snippet — see runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-kv-cache. TL;DR: 1) check cache eviction metrics (prometheus: embeddings_kv_evictions_total), 2) bump cache size in configmap, 3) scale pool, 4) apply model fallback if needed.
Priya Kapoor: runbook excerpt: ```- prometheus query: sum(rate(embeddings_kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (zone)
- configmap edit: kubectl edit cm embeddings-config -n inference-prod -> set kv_cache.max_entries: 200000
- rolling restart: kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeddings-api -n inference-prod```
Riley Chen: applied fallback to model-v1-quant via router -> responses look stable, error rate dropping to ~2% within 90s.
incident-bot: Monitoring update: error_rate 25% -> 3.1% over last 2m. Latency p95 reduced from 1200ms -> 430ms for affected routes.
Aisha Patel: filing ticket for follow-up (post-handoff action): TICKET-4521 (investigate root cause of KV eviction during small-scale load bursts, consider auto-tune of cache). https://tickets.redwood/internal/TICKET-4521
Tom Nguyen: noted. For handoff: I'm covering until 06:00 UTC, then Riley will be primary for EU morning shift. Action items I'll leave in the handoff note.
Aisha Patel: handoff checklist (short): 1) Confirm fallback still active or rollback after stable window. 2) Check allocator backlog for pending gpu scheduling. 3) Verify TICKET-4521 has assignee and CI. 4) Add PM update if customer-visible.
Tom Nguyen: leaving a short runbook pointer in rotation doc: https://docs.redwood/rotation/eu-night. Also adding my logs to the incident page.
Riley Chen: I'll take primary at 06:00 UTC. Quick question re: customer impact comms — do we want to send a status update to affected customers now or wait until we validate stability for 15m?
Priya Kapoor: I think send an initial note now that we mitigated and we're investigating; follow-up with root cause once TICKET-4521 has more details. I'll draft one and ping @Aisha for approval.
Aisha Patel: agree. Priya, please post the draft in #customer-status and tag me.
incident-bot: Note added to incident page: automatic fallback activated -> model-v1-quant; autoscaler backlog observed; ticket created TICKET-4521.
Tom Nguyen: post-handoff action items I'm leaving: - follow up on scheduling capacity with infra team (assigned: Tom) - set alert on embeddings_kv_evictions_total > 100/m (assigned: Riley) - tech debt: consider eviction-resistant cache Q2 (TICKET-4522 placeholder)
Riley Chen: got it. I'll create the alert and link it to the incident.
Aisha Patel: scheduling a short retro (30m) for tomorrow 09:30 UTC — invite: SRE rotation + Eng-ML + Prod Eng. I'll add agenda: timeline, mitigations, capacity shortfall, runbook gaps.
Priya Kapoor: editing incident page notes and adding the customer message draft.
Tom Nguyen: leaving shift now, handing to Riley. anything else?
Riley Chen: nothing from me, thanks Tom. I'll watch the fallback and alerts.
Aisha Patel: thanks team. closing pager for now (monitoring will reopen if >5% errors). Will follow up in retro. :thumbsup:
Priya Kapoor: :thumbsup:
Tom Nguyen: :thumbsup:
